personas.verdict: REVISE (mood-floor miss at phase 6 and close 5, both <7) — but see harm-clause evidence below: this exact failure is a named, documented Watch-for in the file's own maintainer block with a written trainer recovery move, under the training's in-room default delivery (check_pedagogy.md §24). rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Meta-frame lectures are closers, not openers.
rules_evaluated.evidence: orient-and-introspect.md is a curriculum/exercises/ file, not a curriculum/lectures/ file; check_lectures.md's placement rules govern lecture files only.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No cross-module sequencing in lecture bodies.
Slide/lecture headers pass the squint test AND the truth clause.
rules_evaluated.evidence: This rule's numbered scope is lecture/handbook headers; slide-header squint/truth checking for exercise files runs under check_slides.md (a different class), not here.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A slide's BODY is size-bounded, not just its header.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Slide-body sizing is check_slides.md's rule and class; check_lectures.md §5 states the rationale but enforcement belongs to the slides class, not storytelling.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Mood contract named; mood-floor 8+/10 on teaching beats.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Widened to the audience triangle (2026-08-12): mid-layer-competent (8/8) and opinionated-senior (8/7, facilitator-premium) both clear the floor. Fast-operator does not: phase 6, close 5. Harm check — the harm this rule guards against (a teaching moment that silently fails to land) IS present for this persona, but it is not undiscovered: the file's own maintainer block names both exact failure points as Watch-fors ('Introspection skipped', '/context skipped') with a written trainer push for each, under the training's documented in-room default delivery (check_pedagogy.md §24, cohort execution is trainer-paced). The obvious fix — forcing /context or forcing a read of the introspection reply — would convert an adult-agency-respecting optional flow (check_pedagogy.md §10) into a scripted one and risks the exact over-scaffolding §32 warns against. Filed as a rule question, not a body/prompt REVISE: does an audience-triangle mood floor apply per-persona (any persona <7 blocks) or per-artifact-with-documented-trainer-recovery (a Watch-for + push counts as the mitigation this rule already accepts elsewhere)? Recommend the maintainer either add an explicit accept-note on the Watch-fors section naming this carve-out, or scope the mood-floor rule to delivery-mode-matched personas only.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: If maintainer wants a body fix rather than an accept-note: nothing changes the fenced prompts (§16 forcing-function discipline already correct); the only lever left is strengthening the '/context is the slash command...' sentence's imperative shape so a skimming reader's eyes land on the fence, not the description — but this is the same sentence-shape §53/§26 already treat as settled prose, so treat as low-confidence.

rules_evaluated.evidence: Lines 42-43 and the maintainer-attested 10%-heuristic line frame the self-report's unreliability as a working prior held loosely, not a student mistake. The opinionated-senior persona's independent read confirms this lands as honesty rather than hand-waving even under a skeptical lens. Per file's own maintainer note, this phrasing is attested — do-not-edit.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Lead with discipline, not failure mode.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Title 'Orient and map the window' and section headers ('Read your repo deliberately', 'Ask what Claude skipped, and why') name the positive discipline rather than a failure word.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Strategy-fidelity (consolidates front-run check, module-to-module arc, Big Idea fidelity, mood-doesn't-resolve-early).
rules_evaluated.evidence: Big Idea 'the context window is not your codebase' and the target-not-gauge close match the strategy doc's framing. No front-run (file never touches plan mode). Arc: maintainer block's Arc bullet names hand-off to fix-tests-first. Mood doesn't resolve early: all three personas' closes hold 'no fix yet' — even the fast-operator's degraded read still defers to fix-tests-first rather than resolving prematurely.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Forcing functions stay, scripted reactions go; forcing functions live in prompts, not body prose.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The three forcing moves (read the repo, ask what was skipped, run /context) each live in a fenced {{prompt:...}} include, not narrated in body prose. All three personas received the fences identically; the fast-operator's miss is a reading-behavior failure (skims past a fence-adjacent sentence), not a structural forcing-function defect — the mechanism is correctly in the fence per this rule.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Body teaches work; trainer manages room — no authored conversation/pause cues.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No 'discuss with your neighbor' or scheduled pause-cue sentences anywhere in the body across all three persona reads.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Per-exercise leap test — 3 observable Monday outcomes.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Maintainer block's Leap test lists three falsifiable outcomes, each with a scrollback falsifier. The fast-operator persona's trace is itself evidence the leap test's outcome #1 ('runs /context unprompted') is a real, falsifiable, sometimes-missed bar — not evidence the leap test is unfalsifiable or wrongly worded.
